_about: MTPro2 font/slot -> Unicode (hex). Derived from mtp2otf v1.6 mapping data (0BSD), gaps filled from mtpro2.sty symbol names and shared size/weight encodings. Contains no font data. Pieces of composed symbols (the hooks of \hookrightarrow, the bar of \mapsto) map to U+200C (zero-width non-joiner), so the composite copies as its arrow.
